title: West Virginia DMV to sell Cryptid license plates as sample plate for collectors
excerpt: License plate collectors will now be able to buy a Cryptid license plate as a sample plate.
content:
by ANTHONY DAMCOTT

Thu, November 19, 2026 at 6:04 PM

Updated Thu, November 19, 2026 at 6:05 PM

License plate collectors will now be able to buy a Cryptid license plate as a sample plate. (Courtesy of the West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles)

WEST VIRGINIA (WCHS) — License plate collectors will now be able to buy a Cryptid license plate as a sample plate.

According to a press release from the West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles, a sample plate of the Cryptid scenic license plate will be sold beginning Friday at midnight.

The West Virginia DMV stated that the sample plate is for collector use only and is not for vehicle use.

Cryptid license plates were first made available for sale on Nov. 2, with designs by the late West Virginia artist Jesse Corlis. In just the two days after the plates went on sale, the West Virginia DMV said over 1,000 were sold. A run of 3,000 plates was originally produced, but the West Virginia DMV said more were being ordered to keep up with demand.

According to the release on Thursday, over 3,000 plates have been sold in about two and a half weeks.

The West Virginia DMV clarified that Cryptid license plates for vehicle use are available in-person or by phone only, while the sample license plates are only available online. The release said the sample plates have the same original designs by Corlis as the vehicle-use plates do, but are available with nine different sets of lettering to represent the nine Cryptids that appear in the plate.

The state DMV also said that residency in West Virginia is not required to purchase a sample plate.

Sample plates are $25 and beginning at midnight on Friday, you can order yours by clicking here.
